labs.title: Capture and explain your own traffic
labs.purpose: Generate a few harmless local requests, collect a small capture and connect each action to packet evidence.
labs.prerequisites: Client/server basics and the DNS and TCP foundation exercises. Wireshark with loopback capture support.
labs.evidence: Your own controlled loopback capture, request observations and capture settings. Supplied instructions are not a personal capture record.
labs.deliverable: A small reviewed PCAP, annotated exchanges and an explanation of a failed connection.

labs.title: Test and retest access control with Burp
labs.purpose: Use a local two-user training application to compare an insecure object-access check with a repaired version.
labs.prerequisites: HTTP requests, responses and access-control basics. Burp Suite Community and its browser.
labs.evidence: Manual before-and-after requests and responses from an original loopback-only toy application with fictional records.
labs.deliverable: A scoped finding, a denied cross-user request after the fix, and proof that the intended user can still read their record.

labs.title: Write, run and tune an offline detection rule
labs.purpose: Detect one harmless marker in local packet files, then test a near-miss and explain the rule's limits.
labs.prerequisites: Packet basics and a simple Snort rule. Snort 3 in a suitable local lab environment.
labs.evidence: Labelled synthetic PCAP fixtures, an inspectable rule and alerts collected by actually running Snort. A generated fixture is not a real capture.
labs.deliverable: A positive and negative test table, alert evidence, and a short explanation of false positives and missed traffic.

labs.title: Collect Windows events and reconstruct a process chain
labs.purpose: Generate harmless activity in a disposable Windows VM, inspect Sysmon process events and explain parent-child relationships.
labs.prerequisites: Windows processes and the endpoint foundation exercise. A disposable licensed Windows VM with Sysmon configured for the lab.
labs.evidence: Synthetic XML examples for parser practice, followed by a separately labelled collection from your own lab VM.
labs.deliverable: An event timeline, process-GUID relationships and a clear account of missing or incomplete evidence.
labs.minutes: 25–40 minutes for synthetic examples; 30–60 for a prepared VM
